collaborators: A Mirror for the Wise Ruler (or Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government), a vast chronological general history, written by 司马光 Sima Guang (1019-1089) and collaborators during the Northern Song in 1084, covering the period 403 BC-959 AD, 294 scrolls
conveniently: done quickly while doing something else

colleges: Deng Shichang (1849-1894), Qing dynasty naval specialist, founded naval dockyards and two naval colleges, died heroically in action against the Japanese
cookout: to cook a meal over a campfire (usu. for a group of people on an outing)
collocaliini: Aerodramus, genus of birds that use echolocation, a subset of the Collocaliini tribe (swiflets), two of whose species – Aerodramus fuciphagus and Aerodramus maximus – build nests harvested to make bird's nest soup
kwantung: Japanese Kwantung army (or Kantō army), notorious for numerous atrocities in China during WWII
cognoscenti: (of an uneducated person) to mingle with the cognoscenti
colchicus: (bird species of China) common pheasant (Phasianus colchicus)
colchicu: (bird species of China) common pheasant (Phasianus colchicus)

copti: Chinese goldthread (Coptis chinensis), rhizome used in medicine
